description: This file defines the class InputManagerV9, a Java class that manages input devices on Android. It handles device connection status, registration of listeners, and device event notifications, including monitoring device disconnections.

classes.name: InputManagerV9
classes.description: Manages input device connections and states, notifies registered listeners of device events, and handles device disconnection checks on Android.

classes.name: PollingMessageHandler
classes.description: An internal Handler subclass responsible for periodically checking whether input devices have disconnected.

classes.name: DeviceEvent
classes.description: Encapsulates device event notifications (add, change, remove) and runs the callback on the appropriate listener.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Returns an InputDevice object for a given device ID.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns an array of currently connected input device IDs, updating internal state with any new devices.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for input device events, with an optional handler.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Removes a previously registered input device listener.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles motion events to detect new input devices when motions are detected.
